source.coordinate_convention: Pixel coordinates from top-left; boxes are [x, y, width, height], estimated to visible outer extents. Right/bottom are exclusive. Grouped entries describe repeated elements and state their count and layout.

reconstruction_limits.recoverable: Visible pixels and visible silhouettes can be isolated as pixel-accurate masks, including antialiased edges, where boundaries are distinguishable.
reconstruction_limits.not_recoverable: Pixels hidden behind foreground objects, UI, water, characters, effects, or frame borders cannot be recovered from this flattened image. A clean plate in those locations is an artistic reconstruction, not source truth.
reconstruction_limits.forbidden_shortcut: The full source image is not a semantic layer and cannot stand in for the requested reconstruction.

elements.description: Dark blue-black masonry perimeter and dungeon wall framing the playfield; irregular chipped stone surfaces, staggered visible seams and scattered moss. The detailed annotations define 676 mortar-landmark brick cells across 19 wall zones, with 659 nonempty visible brick masks, plus 380 supplemental source-texture fragments. Some physical bricks are occluded and marked as such; source masks do not restore hidden surfaces.

Gray-blue square flagstone combat floor with dark grout, worn chips, mottled highlights and puddle-like texture. Mean pitch is roughly 75 px; individual visible mortar landmarks vary and are recorded in grid metadata. Visible lines may be occluded by entities and effects, so hidden continuation is not claimed.

grid.note: Source floor is irregular and interrupted. These are manually inferred mortar landmarks from scene annotation; do not force a perfect uniform grid where these boundaries deviate.

elements.description: Heavy foreground/bottom masonry ledge with broken crenellated upper edge; integrates pipework, moss and inset blocks.

Several irregular bright cyan-blue water channels/pools interrupt the floor: upper-left pool, left mid-channel, central scattered flooded cells, upper-right channel, right-middle vertical fall/pool, and lower-right pool/channel. Animated-looking cyan foam, ripples and white glints are painted in the still image.

Staggered rectangular masonry courses with dark mortar and cool blue highlights. The wall annotation uses a 19-zone mortar landmark map with 676 authored cells, 659 nonempty visible brick masks, plus 380 supplemental source-texture fragments. Manual seams group visible texture fragments according to visible brick edges. These masks cover only source-visible pixels and do not recover original editable brick art or hidden stone faces.

Sixteen manually bounded green vine/moss patches on the walls and floor edges, especially upper center, upper right, left wall, lower center-right and lower-right wall. Seventeen `vine-edge` children preserve exposed leaf fringes by parent patch; combine the parent and its child fringes when assembling one visible patch. Cropped or occluded leaf pixels are unavailable.

Approximately 12 major pipe runs assembled from 54 individually annotated tube/collar/mounting segments (31 pipe-joint and 23 pipe-tube regions), plus separately described machine/control panels. Visible hardware includes brass/iron tubes, bands, rivets, mouths, elbows and mounting plates in the north, west, east and southeast walls. Segment masks preserve visible pixels; they do not fill occluded pipe portions.

Three waterfall outlets: west, east and southeast; source annotations give separate waterfall masks and two visible outlet frames (the third outlet is integrated into the pipe/stone boundary). Each outlet has visible arch/frame, descending water, splash and connected pool. See semantic component records for individual masks.
Wall-mounted sconces with bright yellow-orange flames flanking exit alcove; left around x849,y64, right around x1138,y64.
Raised stone-and-metal exit doorway at top center, striped gold/black side rails, illuminated inner steps and large glowing yellow upward arrow on a square floor plate.

Four iron floor grates: west floor grate [319,516,63,66], east floor grate [1102,298,96,70], south floor grate [730,590,79,65], and west tall grate [74,468,53,99]. Each has separate rim and grid bars in scene annotations.

Four crate stacks, seven visible wood-panel pieces: west upper [79,314,82,52] and lower [81,367,79,44]; east upper [1363,253,73,60] and under panel [1368,313,63,41]; east lower [1363,433,68,62]; south upper [554,687,42,45] and lower [555,731,40,32]. Each visible piece is separately annotated. Bounding extent is a loose family envelope.
Red metal explosive barrel, black bands, bright yellow hazard mark and lid highlights.
Small gold/orange spark or reflected-light flecks on floor at scattered positions; decorative, not a path indicator.
Brown-haired bearded muscular man, tan skin, green pack/shoulder gear, white shorts with red spots, bare feet, facing right in a punch/ready pose. Green health bar above. Occupies highlighted tile.
Small orange-black-white cat with gold crown, facing right; cyan selection/status dot appears only in bottom portrait strip. Green bar above.

Purple-haired woman in dark purple outfit with bulky silver armored gauntlet, facing right. Green bar above. Scene mask family is katia-body plus child katia-purple-hair-edge; combine these visible masks for the actor silhouette while retaining the child semantic edge annotation.

Red feathered bird/dragon-like ally with blue head/crest, facing right. Green bar above and cyan dot in bottom portrait strip. Scene mask family is mongo-body plus child mongo-red-feather-edge; combine these visible masks for the actor silhouette while retaining the child semantic edge annotation.
Dark gray rat with red eyes and long pink tail, facing left; red health bar; enclosed by red target brackets and pointed to by red chevron.
Dark gray rat with red eyes and pink tail, facing left; red health bar above.
Dark gray rat with red eyes and pink tail, facing left; red health bar above.
Cream parchment banner with gold/dark ornamental border and lantern icon at left. Exact text: 'OPEN THE EXIT'.
Dark navy panel with gold outline, stepped/tabbed lower edge. Text: 'PARTY PHASE • ROUND 2'. Three diamond markers beneath; first two glowing cyan, third gray outline.

Yellow glowing outline around Carl's tile at [457,476,96,82], followed by three consecutive cyan outlined movement cells [552,487,193,72]. The first tile contains Carl; path continues right toward target.
Four thick red corner brackets around rat-target and red downward chevron above; bright red glow.
Dark speech panel, thin yellow border, pointed yellow tail aimed toward target. Text exactly 'Strike • 2 Mana'.

elements.layout: horizontal, four evenly spaced portrait cards
elements.description: Four square face portraits in gold/dark beveled frames, left-to-right Carl, crowned cat, purple-haired woman, red bird. Carl card has bright selected gold glow; other cards have dark blue inset. Cyan ready marker dots at upper-right on all four cards, including Carl.

Full-width navy/black HUD frame with ornate gold beveled outer edge, inner pale gold keyline and clipped/angled corners. Contains selected hero status, move counter, four action buttons, forecast and end-turn control. Scene annotation has 106 UI regions: individual frame/body, every readable text token, icons, bar outline/track/fill, seven world HP outline/track/fill sets, portrait artwork/backings, buttons and dividers; see semantic_components.
Large portrait of Carl in a gold beveled frame, head and shoulders.
Large gold all-caps serif name.
HP label, current/max values, horizontal dark outlined track with red fill at 32/40.
Mana label, current/max values, horizontal dark outlined track with cyan fill at 8/12.
Brown leather boot icon, large numeral 4 and 'Move' label beneath/right.

elements.layout: horizontal, equal-size cards with small gutters
elements.description: Each button has a near-black navy fill, gold beveled outline, subtle dark inset and icon above serif white label. Move [531,851,111,115] selected with bright outer glow and cyan footprint icon. Strike [650,851,111,115] sword icon. Skills [770,851,111,115] purple circular swirl icon. Items [889,851,112,115] brown potion/bag icon.
Dark navy gold-edged horizontal panel. Rat portrait at left; text at right: 'Rat' in white and '12 damage' with 12 in red. The rat forecast is separate from the target callout.
Large cream parchment-like button, thick gold beveled outline and dark inset. Text exactly 'End Carl’s turn' and dark right-pointing triangular arrow at right.
Composition root. HUD elements overlay both dungeon and lower margin; objective and phase banners overlay upper wall.

layer_order_back_to_front: scene.exit-door, scene.waterfalls, scene.torches, scene.grates, scene.crates, scene.explosive-barrel, scene.floor-glints
entity characters and their health bars

annotation_sources.purpose: Detailed source-visible scene masks and polygons, including 676 mortar-landmark brick cells across 19 wall zones (659 nonempty visible masks), 380 supplemental source-texture fragments, 13 capstone rows, individually annotated floor slabs, pipe tubes/joints and mounting plates, water, actors and corrected selection-ground wedge, seven world HP bars, props, targeting and movement markers.
Detailed UI semantic regions, including frame/body/fills, separate text tokens, icons, portrait elements, bars, dividers, indicators and forecast-pointer.
